containers.name: mymo
containers.description: MyMo app source files, shared across multiple projects/pipelines, not specific to any single one.

containers.name: ToLAKE
containers.description: Shared FTP drop location used by several projects' datalake pipelines, not exclusive to any one pipeline.

containers.name: mymo_transaction_limit
containers.description: A log capturing all transactions that were blocked due to limit restrictions. Gzipped daily file: mymo_transaction_limit_<yyyymmdd>.csv.gz, pipe-delimited, with header, with a companion mymo_transaction_limit_<yyyymmdd>.cksum for validation.

columns.name: limit
columns.description: Initial limit set by the system before the customer adjusts it (Limit)

columns.name: spentroom
columns.description: Remaining daily limit available for use (SpentRoom)

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount of the transaction made that day (Amount)

columns.name: app_mode
columns.description: Customer's application mode: L = MyMo Secure plus, N = MyMo normal mode (AppMode)

columns.name: limit_mode
columns.description: Customer's limit mode, derived from AppMode + Tier: SECURE_PLUS, NORMAL, SMALL (LimitMode)

containers.name: mymo_set_limit
containers.description: A log capturing all limit-adjustment activities performed through the MyMo application. Gzipped daily file: mymo_set_limit_<yyyymmdd>.csv.gz, pipe-delimited, with header, with a companion mymo_set_limit_<yyyymmdd>.cksum for validation.

columns.name: pre_limit
columns.description: Initial limit set by the system before the customer adjusts it (PreLimit)

columns.name: changing_limit
columns.description: Daily limit amount after adjustment / post limit (ChangingLimit)

columns.name: limit_mode
columns.description: Customer's limit mode, derived from AppMode + Tier: SECURE_PLUS, NORMAL, SMALL (LimitMode)
